page.overview:
What is Allfaiths Shrine?

The Allfaiths Shrine was a non-denominational, wayside shrine in the village of Red Larch.

The shrine was situated on the western side of the Long Road, south of the Swinging Sword Inn.

The shrine was constructed of stone and said to resemble a grand mansion. At its entrance were two wide wooden doors, each painted with the holy symbols of numerous gods.

The interior of the shrine was rather plain and had a simple stone altar. In the back of the shrine were two rooms for visiting priests to sleep in.
